findings.claim: The focus effect unconditionally sets the camera active and resets the scanned flag when the screen regains focus, even if an error overlay is currently shown for an invalid address. This puts a live camera behind the error overlay and can trigger scan logic on a new frame before the user dismisses the overlay, so the effect should be gated on the absence of an error message or the error should be cleared on focus.

The focus effect unconditionally sets the camera active and resets the scanned flag when the screen regains focus, even if an error overlay is currently shown for an invalid address. This puts a live camera behind the error overlay and can trigger scan logic on a new frame before the user dismisses the overlay, so the effect should be gated on the absence of an error message or the error should be cleared on focus.

handledRef is not reset on focus cleanup; it currently only works because the address path unmounts the scanner via router.replace. If a future code path keeps the scanner mounted instead of unmounting it, handledRef staying true would silently suppress all subsequent scans with no indication to the user, so the invariant should be documented with a comment or the ref should be reset in the cleanup.

The test mocks parsePrefixedAddress and isValidAddress transitively even though the hook now calls resolveScannedAddress, coupling the test to internal implementation helpers rather than the actual dependency; mocking @/src/components/Camera/scannedAddress directly would reduce this coupling.

The import reaches directly into @/src/components/Camera/useCameraPermissionFlow instead of using the barrel export at apps/mobile/src/components/Camera/index.ts, which is already used for other Camera imports in the same file, creating inconsistency.

Date.now().toString() is used for scanTimestamp, but two rapid taps landing within the same millisecond produce identical values, so the route would not treat them as a new event; a monotonic counter or ref-based increment would be more deterministic.
